scope: Tiny deterministic local contracts; runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Validate the prepared dependency family
cases.input_contract: Construct an org.apache.spark coordinate for a lowercase hyphenated artifact base, requiring Scala binary 2.13 and Spark target 4.0.1. Reject other binary/version tuples and malformed base names. Do not download anything.
cases.expected: spark-sql,2.13,4.0.1 yields org.apache.spark:spark-sql_2.13:4.0.1. Binary 3 or 2.12 and version 4.2.0 are outside this prepared target contract.
cases.verification: Assert the exact coordinate and catch each unsupported tuple or malformed artifact base.

cases.title: Keep execution local and bounded
cases.input_contract: Accept exactly local[2] as the course master and reject remote addresses, local[*] and null. Return the accepted value without starting a session.
cases.expected: local[2] passes;local[*], spark://example:7077 and null raise IllegalArgumentException.
cases.verification: Assert the accepted literal and all three rejected values with no network action.

cases.title: Capture data instead of a resource owner
cases.input_contract: Return a multiplier closure that copies only owner.factor into a local immutable value. Require factor and input magnitude at most 1000000 so multiplication is within Long range. Do not retain owner or its nonserializable resource.
cases.expected: Owner factor 3 produces 7->21 and-2->-6. An input outside the bounded domain is rejected. The function is suitable for the later serialization check.
cases.verification: Assert both signed results and the domain rejection, then compare serializability with owner.bad in Exercise 4.

cases.title: Observe the captured object graph
cases.input_contract: Serialize a locally constructed object into an in-memory byte array and return its byte size, closing the stream. Demonstrate that the safe closure serializes and owner.bad fails with NotSerializableException.
cases.expected: The safe closure produces a positive byte count; the bad closure retaining Owner raises NotSerializableException. No file or external service is used.
cases.verification: Assert positive size for safe and catch the exact serialization exception for owner.bad.

cases.title: Verify behavior after a local serialization round trip
cases.input_contract: Serialize the supplied local function to memory, deserialize only those self-produced bytes and return the recovered function. Close both streams. Compare original and recovered outputs on a bounded fixture.
cases.expected: The safe factor 3 closure returns identical results after round trip for-2,0,7. The check proves more than a nonempty byte array.
cases.verification: Assert exact output equality for all three inputs and an expected 21 result for 7.

cases.title: Separate runtime readback from a target declaration
cases.input_contract: Return actual Scala version and Java specification version plus the declared spark_target4.0.1. Do not label the target string as an observed Spark runtime version. The prepared foundation profile should report Scala 2.13 and Java 17.
cases.expected: Keys are scala_actual, java_actual, spark_target. Scala starts with 2.13., Java is 17, and target is 4.0.1. Exact Scala patch comes from the run.
cases.verification: Assert the keys and version families, then retain the printed runtime line as platform-specific evidence.
